note.question: What determines the value of the seller’s ability to observe the buyer’s arrival time in terms of her expected revenue?
note.overview: The model considers a dynamic pricing problem in which a firm sells one item to a single buyer to maximize expected revenue. The firm commits to a price function over an infinite horizon. The buyer arrives at some random time with a private value for the item.
